Error: [VULNERABILITY] Credit Note GL Drift — Invoice Void Did Not Restore AR Balance
  Invoice      : INV/2026/06/04/000245 (ID: 49bc857e-57f1-44c0-9ae1-8d3adc91d6e8)
  AR Account   : a9331f21-418e-45e2-850b-8240bc8b80ff
  AR Before    : 1945382.59
  AR After Inv : 1949882.59 (correctly increased by 800)
  AR After Void: 1939882.59 (should have returned to 1945382.59)
  Drift        : 5500.00 (must be 0.00)
  Root Cause   : Void is posting a NEW credit entry instead of reversing the original debit. Net AR movement is -11000.00 instead of 0. Double-posting bug in void journal logic.
Audit: Credit note (void) must reduce AR balance back to pre-sale state
